# kbcli v0.4.0

**Release date:** 2026-11-24 · **Previous release:** [v0.3.1](https://github.com/ProjAnvil/kbcli/releases/tag/v0.3.1) · **License:** MIT · **Go:** 1.27.4

This minor release makes multilingual retrieval a first-class workflow. It adds
retrieval profiles, local token-level reranking with the existing embedder,
automatic KB language detection, translation on quick-RAG routes, and a
headless answer command for agents and other tools. The settings screen now
puts profile, embedding and reranking controls on one page, with LLM
credentials separated into their own sidebar.

> **Heads up:** existing configurations keep `profile: custom` behaviour. To
> opt into the supported multilingual stack, run
> `kbcli config set profile multilingual` and rebuild the index once with
> `kbcli reindex`.

See the [full diff](https://github.com/ProjAnvil/kbcli/compare/v0.3.1...v0.4.0)
and [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/ProjAnvil/kbcli/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md)
for the complete entry.

---

## Highlights

- **Retrieval profiles.** `local`, `multilingual` and `custom` select or
  enforce a supported embedder, translation and reranker combination. Every
  forced change is reported with a reason.
- **Multilingual by default when you need it.** The `multilingual` profile
  combines `rembed`, hybrid retrieval, query translation and local MaxSim
  reranking. No external rerank API and no second model download.
- **Local token-level reranking.** `local_maxsim` reuses token vectors from the
  active `rembed` model to rescore candidates. Token vectors are computed at
  query time and are not written to `.kbvec`.
- **Cross-language parity.** English and mixed-language questions against a
  Chinese corpus now translate into the KB language before retrieval and
  reranking. Definition-style queries that previously returned unrelated PDFs
  now return the same top chunks as their Chinese equivalents.
- **Headless answers.** `kbcli ask --json` returns a machine-readable envelope
  for agents, scripts and CI: answer, ranked hits, profile, intent, language
  detection, translation status and degradation reason.
- **Settings redesign.** `Profile & Models` is the first sidebar. It shows the
  effective stack and policy notes. `LLM` holds provider and API credentials.

---

## What's Changed

### Added

- `config.Profile` with `local`, `multilingual` and `custom`. `ApplyProfile`
  records forced changes as `PolicyNote` values and re-applies after workspace
  overrides are resolved.
- `rerank_type: local_maxsim`. `embed.TokenEmbedder` exposes `rembed` token
  hidden states to the retrieval layer for MaxSim scoring.
- `kb_language` and `query_translation`. `auto` detects the corpus language by
  chunk-level majority vote and honours `language` / `lang` chunk metadata.
- `kbcli ask <question>` with `--json` and `--explain`. Stable exit codes:
  `0` success, `2` config error, `3` no index, `4` LLM failure and `5`
  retrieval failure.
- Query language, KB language and translated query fields in TUI diagnostics
  and headless JSON output.
- Settings regression tests for the new sidebar groups and first-page
  `profile` field.

### Changed

- `quick_rag` still skips condensing and query transforms, but no longer skips
  query translation. Simple definitional queries are the main beneficiaries.
- Reranking runs against `searchQ`, the query actually used for evidence
  search, instead of the original-language query.
- Settings catalog grew from 49 to 52 fields in 8 groups. The previous
  `Rerank` sidebar was merged into `Profile & Models`.
- Both READMEs now document profile selection, headless usage and warm
  latency/recall trade-offs.

### Fixed

- English queries against a Chinese corpus no longer let an English PDF win
  by query-language bias. In a 4.5 MB mixed corpus, `什么是系统设计`,
  `what is system design` and `what's 系统设计` returned the same top five
  chunks with the `multilingual` profile.
- `kb_language: auto` no longer classifies a Chinese corpus as English merely
  because code and identifiers contain many Latin letters.
- Policy-forced settings remain enforced when per-workspace overrides are
  applied.

### Tests

- `go build ./...`, `go vet ./...` and `go test -race -count=1 ./...` pass.
- Added tests for profile enforcement, local MaxSim, quick-RAG translation,
  corpus language voting and headless command wiring.

---

## Breaking Changes

None. Existing configurations without `profile` continue to use `custom`,
which preserves pre-v0.4.0 behaviour. Settings sidebar names changed, but
configuration keys remain backward compatible.

---

## Upgrade Guide

1. **Install v0.4.0** (see [Installation](#installation)).
2. **Keep the existing stack:** do nothing. `profile` defaults to `custom`.
3. **Opt into multilingual retrieval:**

   ```sh
   kbcli config set profile multilingual
   kbcli reindex
   ```

4. **Use profile-specific defaults deliberately:**

   | Profile | Recommended for |
   | --- | --- |
   | `local` | pure-Chinese or identifier-heavy corpora where startup speed matters |
   | `multilingual` | mixed-language users or English queries into non-English corpora |
   | `custom` | reproducing older behaviour or testing unsupported combinations |

5. **For agents and scripts:**

   ```sh
   kbcli ask "what is system design" --json --dir ./docs
   ```

6. **Measure before and after:**

   ```sh
   kbcli eval --samples 50
   kbcli search "什么是系统设计" --json
   kbcli search "what is system design" --json
   ```

## Installation

### From source

```sh
go install github.com/ProjAnvil/kbcli/cmd/kbcli@v0.4.0
# or
go install github.com/ProjAnvil/kbcli/cmd/kbcli@latest
```

Requires Go 1.27.4 or newer. `make install` also works from a checkout.

### Prebuilt binaries

Each release publishes normal binaries and full offline archives.

| Tier | Asset name | Contents |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Normal | `kbcli-v0.4.0-<os>-<arch>` | Binary only. |
| Full | `kbcli-full-v0.4.0-<os>-<arch>.tar.gz` | Binary plus `model/ms-marco-MiniLM-L-6-v2/`. |

Platforms: `darwin-amd64`, `darwin-arm64`, `linux-amd64`, `linux-arm64`,
`windows-amd64`.

## Verify

```sh
kbcli version                       # v0.4.0
kbcli config get profile            # custom for upgraded configs
kbcli config keys | grep '^'        # 52 fields in 8 groups
kbcli ask "what is system design" --json --dir ./docs
kbcli eval --samples 20 --dir ./docs
```

Expected headless diagnostics with `profile: multilingual` and a Chinese KB:

```json
{
  "query_language": "en",
  "kb_language": "zh",
  "translation_applied": true,
  "search_query": "什么是系统设计",
  "degraded": false
}
```

---

## Known Issues

- `multilingual` has higher cold-start latency because `rembed` weights load
  once per process. Warm queries reuse the cached model.
- The bundled `local` profile is lexical and hash-based. It is fast but does
  not provide multilingual semantic retrieval.
- `local_maxsim` needs an embedder with token-vector support. It runs with
  `rembed`; the `local` hash embedder does not support it.
- The vector width is fixed at 384. Models with 768 or 1024 dimensions are not
  usable yet.
- `kbcli eval` is a self-retrieval smoke test, not a question-answer benchmark.
- Retrieval still uses an exact brute-force scan with a full sort. An ANN
  index and vector quantization are not implemented.
- Windows runtime behaviour has not been verified on real hardware.
